EN:
{{TAG:0003:0020:}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Winter Solstice{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} makes me think
about pumpkins.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}} Punch through one,
and you won't catch a cold!
{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0012:}}What?! You're saying pumpkins 
don't work that way?! They're only
good for eating?!
{{TAG:0003:0002:}}Ha ha! Come on! Anybody can eat
'em. It takes a true tough guy to
punch 'em! {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0020:}}El solsticio de invierno a mí me
hace pensar en calabazas.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}} ¡Yo les
doy puñetazos y se me quita el frío!
{{TAG:0003:0012:}}¡¿Qué?! ¿Dices que las calabazas
no son para eso? ¡¿Que son
para comer?!
{{TAG:0003:0002:}}¡Ja, ja! ¡Venga ya! Comérselas es
demasiado fácil. ¡Hace falta ser
muy hombre para zurrarlas!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0020:}}Le solstice d'hiver me fait toujours
penser aux citrouilles.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Transperces-en une d'un direct bien
envoyé et tu passeras un hiver sans
rhume,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}C'est ce que ma maman avait
coutume de dire, en tout cas.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0012:}}Hein ?! Une citrouille, c'est fait pour
être mangé et pas autre chose, tu
dis ?
{{TAG:0003:0002:}}Ha ha !{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} Arrête ! C'est à la portée de
n'importe qui ! Les éclater à coups
de poing, par contre...{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0020:}}Il solstizio di inverno mi fa pensare
alle zucche.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}} Io le uso per migliorare
i miei colpi di karate.
{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0012:}}Nessun altro lo fa? E tu che ne sai?
Dici che dovrei mangiarle?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0002:}}Facciamo così, prima le taglio in due
con un colpo e poi le mangio,
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0020:}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Kış Gündönümü{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} bana balkabağını
hatırlatıyor.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}} Bir tanesine yumruğu geçir,
soğuk algınlığı olmazsın!
{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0012:}}Ne?! Balkabağı öyle çalışmıyor mu diyorsun?!
Sadece yenir mi?!
{{TAG:0003:0002:}}Ha ha! Hadi ama! Yemeyi herkes becerir.
Balkabağına yumruk atmak gerçek sert adam
işidir! {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0020:}}You can't have {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Winter Solstice{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}
without a hot, lemony bath!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}If you can hold your breath under
the hot, lemony water for over 10
seconds, you won't catch a cold!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0012:}}What?! You're saying it should be
enough to just soak in the hot,
lemony water?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0002:}}Ha ha! That's a boring way to build
a cold-busting body! {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0020:}}¡No puede haber un solsticio de
invierno sin un buen baño caliente!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Si aguantas la respiración diez
segundos bajo el agua, ¡eso quiere
decir que no cogerás un catarro!
{{TAG:0003:0012:}}¡¿Qué?! ¿Dices que eso son
supersticiones sin fundamento?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0002:}}¡Ja, ja! Sí, ¿y qué? ¡A veces hay que
creer en tonterías para que la vida
sea más llevadera, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0020:}}Lors du solstice d'hiver, rien de tel
qu'un bain bien chaud !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Si tu parviens à y rester en apnée
plus de 10 secondes, tu ne prendras
pas froid une seule fois cet hiver !
{{TAG:0003:0012:}}Hein ?! Comment ça, faire
trempette suffit amplement ?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0002:}}Ha ha ! Où est le fun là-dedans,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}
{{TAG:0005:0007:}} ?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0020:}}Quando arriva l'inverno mi concedo
sempre un bagno rilassante
agli agrumi.
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Inoltre, se stai sott'acqua per 10
secondi, non ti becchi l'influenza
nei mesi più freddi!
{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0012:}}Come? Non conoscevi questo
trucchetto?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0002:}}Dovresti provare, ma non ti
assicuro che funzioni, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0020:}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Mittwinter {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}ohne Zitronenbad ist
wie Sport ohne Schweiß!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Tauch deinen Kopf zehn Sekunden
ins heiße Zitronenwasser, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}und der
Winter bleibt erkältungsfrei!
{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0002:}}Haha! {{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}Eigentlich könnte ich ja auch
einfach joggen und meinen Körper
richtig heiß laufen lassen!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0020:}}Sıcak, limonlu bir banyo olmadan {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Kış
Gündönümü{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} olur mu!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Sıcak limonlu suyun
altında nefesini 10
saniyeden fazla tutarsan üşütmezsin!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0012:}}Ne?!
Sadece sıcak limonlu suda beklemek
yeter mi diyorsun?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0002:}}Ha ha! Soğuk
algınlığına dayanıklı beden
yapmanın ne sıkıcı yolu! {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}It's dark all day, so it might be
a little dangerous out there today{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0021:}}I'll have to be extra careful when I
go out on patrol around town!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Va a estar oscuro todo el día,
así que hay que andarse con
mucho ojo por ahí en estas horas{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0021:}}¡Iré con muchísimo cuidado al salir
a hacer mi ronda por el pueblo
para no caerme de narices!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Toute cette obscurité, c'est pas
franchement rassurant{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0021:}}Je vais devoir redoubler d'attention
lors de ma prochaine ronde !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Questo buio fa paura a molti{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0021:}}Ma non a me! La città è sicura
se ci sono io di guardia!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Bütün gün karanlık olduğu için bugün dışarısı
biraz tehlikeli olabilir{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0021:}}Kasabada
devriyeye çıkarken ekstra dikkatli
olmam gerekecek!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}When it's dark all day like this,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} I get
a little worried{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} that maybe the sun
will never rise again.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}}If that ever happened, I'd never be
able to get suntanned again!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} That
would be terrible,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}À chaque solstice d'hiver, c'est la
même chose :{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} j'ai peur que le jour
ne revienne jamais...
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}T'imagines ?!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Si ça arrivait,
comment on ferait pour bronzer ?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Bonjour l'angoisse...{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Chissà dove si nasconde il sole
quando è notte...{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Se lo scoprissi, andrei lì e mi
allenerei 24 ore su 24!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Sarebbe
un sogno,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}An {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Mittwinter {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}hab ich immer ein
bisschen Angst, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}dass die Sonne nie
wieder aufgeht!
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Ohne Sonne könnte ich nur mit
'ner Taschenlampe joggen gehen!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}
Wie schrecklich,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Bütün gün böyle karanlık olunca,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} güneş bir
daha hiç doğmayacak diye biraz
endişeleniyorum{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Öyle bir şey olursa
bir daha hiç bronzlaşamam!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}
Bu korkunç olur,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}When the {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Winter Solstice{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} comes, it
makes me feel the real winter is
finally here!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Everything else is just a warm-up.
Or a cold-up, I guess. Either way, I
better get to exercising!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Cuando viene el solsticio de
invierno, ¡sí que me queda claro
que hemos cambiado de estación!
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Todo lo demás ha sido un
calentamiento para el enfriamiento.
¿Entiendes? Bueno, pues eso...
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Il solstizio invernale segna l'inizio
del vero inverno!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Con il freddo, bisogna fare molta
attenzione prima di un allenamento
e riscaldarsi per bene.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Spätestens an {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Mittwinter {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}merke ich,
dass wir Winter haben!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0014:}}Dieser Tag ist immer tierisch kalt!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:002C:}}Aber ein echter Sportler lässt sich
davon nicht unterkriegen!
TRANSLATION:

ısınmaydı. Ya da soğumaydı
